title: Ookiku Furikabutte: Natsu no Taikai-hen - Mokuhyou
justification: AniList 9124 (OVA, 1 episode from 2010-12-22) is AniDB 7291's special S1 Mokuhyou (Goals), aired 2010-12-22. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 7720, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 7291, and the special's title matches AniList's romaji title (Mokuhyou) and English title (Big Windup! 2: Goals). The parent's row places S1 on TVDB 0x2 Goals (2010-12-22) and, with the TMDB row, on TMDB 45532 S0E2 Goals (2010-12-23, TMDB's date is a day later).
